name: Morse.IsNormalRadius
why: Project: Nonempty NormalCoord (open O, U ⊆ V, smooth ambient F, G extending exp_q|B_ε and its inverse, U ∩ N = exp_q(B_ε)); blind: exp_q defined and C^∞ on B_ε ⊆ T_qN, exp_q(B_ε) open in N ∋ q, with a locally-smoothly-extendable inverse. Equal for all N, q, ε: project ⇒ blind by restriction (ψ = π ∘ G); blind ⇒ project with F = exp_q ∘ π and G obtained by gluing the local extensions with a smooth partition of unity on an open set (glue, from Mathlib's exists_contMDiffMap_forall_mem_convex_of_local).
